claim_revisions.subject: Quantized Majorana conductance, Nature, 28 March 2018, DOI 10.1038/nature26142
claim_revisions.statement: On 8 March 2021, Nature published a retraction note to “Quantized Majorana conductance”, which the note states “was published on 28 March 2018”. The note lists “Leo P. Kouwenhoven” under “Microsoft Station Q Delft”. The 2018 letter states “Here we report a quantized conductance plateau at 2 e 2 / h”. The retraction note states the authors “can therefore no longer claim the observation of a quantized Majorana conductance, and wish to retract this Letter.”

evidence.quote: Microsoft Station Q Delft, 2600 GA, Delft, The Netherlands
We can therefore no longer claim the observation of a quantized Majorana conductance, and wish to retract this Letter.
Here we report a quantized conductance plateau at 2 e 2 / h in the zero-bias conductance measured in indium antimonide semiconductor nanowires covered with an aluminium superconducting shell.
Microsoft Station Q Delft, Delft, 2600 GA, The Netherlands

gaps.why: On 2 Oct 2026 the Alice & Bob homepage, a newsroom roadmap URL, the December 2024 long and short roadmap PDFs, and a blog URL returned HTTP 403. A Wayback request for the long PDF returned HTTP 429. No sentences from those pages are recorded here.
gaps.would_need: A successful fetch of the roadmap PDF or the newsroom page, saved with its capture date.

gaps.topic: D-Wave Clarity items left out of the target list
gaps.why: The 2021 Clarity PDF also schedules mixed-integer hybrid solvers and a unified hybrid interface in 2022-2023, cross-platform solvers and vertical solvers in 2023-2024, in-region systems in North America and the European Union in 2021-2022, and an application marketplace plus Asia Pacific in-region systems in 2023-2024. A 2025+ connectivity line has no end date. Five gate-model phases have no calendar year, including a 60-qubit system and a 1000-qubit system. Company newsroom year pages list only a handful of items, so they were not treated as a complete archive and those sentences were not given a delivery result.
gaps.would_need: A press release or filing for each dated bullet, or a newsroom archive that is complete enough to support a search log.

gaps.topic: D-Wave S-4 rows without a stored figure
gaps.why: The 15 March 2022 projections table also prints percent growth, a percent margin, and an adjusted EBITDA margin. Those rows are not stored as separate projections. Adjusted EBITDA for 2022E, 2023E, and 2024E is printed in parentheses in the same row as the later positive amounts. Those three amounts are not stored, because a figure value has to be non-negative and a parenthetical amount is not recorded here as a positive number. The Revenue row is marked (1) while footnote (1) defines gross profit; the revenue figures are the Revenue row as printed. The fiscal year 2022 Form 10-K HTML was not retrieved: a Wayback request returned HTTP 429. Companyfacts XBRL was not used as a quotation. The S-4 also contains other forward-looking sentences beyond this table, so the document is partial.
gaps.would_need: The fiscal year 2022 Form 10-K HTML for a revenue quotation, and a decision on how to store parenthetical adjusted EBITDA if a later schema allows it.

gaps.why: The fiscal year 2024 Form 10-K copy used here came from a Wayback year gate (web/2025/) rather than a day-stamped capture. The filing date 14 March 2025 is taken from the SEC submissions JSON on data.sec.gov.
gaps.would_need: A day-stamped Wayback capture, or the filing HTML from data.sec.gov.

gaps.topic: Microsoft roadmap posts without a calendar due date
gaps.why: The 21 June 2023 Azure Quantum post at https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/quantum/2023/06/21/microsoft-achieves-first-milestone-towards-a-quantum-supercomputer/ lists six milestones and marks the first as achieved. Later milestones in that post are not given calendar dates, including a stated scale of one million rQOPS. The 19 February 2025 post at https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/quantum/2025/02/19/microsoft-unveils-majorana-1-the-worlds-first-quantum-processor-powered-by-topological-qubits/ says the path is in years, not decades, which is not a calendar due date. Those sentences are not targets.
gaps.would_need: A Microsoft document that puts a calendar date on one of those later milestones.

gaps.topic: PsiQuantum sentences without a calendar date
gaps.why: The 29 April 2024 Australia release says the first system will be “in the regime of 1 million physical qubits” and states an investment amount, but those sentences do not give a calendar date. They are not assigned the site's end-of-2027 date. An earlier wire release did not download (HTTP/2 error).
gaps.would_need: A PsiQuantum document that dates the qubit-count sentence, and a successful copy of the earlier wire release.

gaps.topic: Xanadu release beyond the dated bullets
gaps.why: The 31 August 2026 release includes a safe-harbor list of forward-looking categories beyond the dated bullets entered here, so the document is partial. The live investors page was not retrieved in this session. The quotations are from a Wayback capture on 3 Sep 2026 that was already on disk and copied into this scratch folder. A repeat Wayback request returned HTTP 429.
gaps.would_need: A fresh fetch of the investors release, and a decision about whether any safe-harbor sentence is a separate dated item.

gaps.why: After the 1 May 2024 release, which still refers to a next generation quantum chip, https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/research/quantum-computing.html returned HTTP 403. A full newsroom crawl for a later chip-release announcement was not completed. The search log lists only the pages that were opened.
gaps.would_need: Intel newsroom pages from later in 2024 and from 2025 that either announce the chip or do not.
